ghi_chu: Cac cau CHI hien khi nguoi dung khong du quyen. Ghim (file, khoa kho chuoi) — KHONG ghim so dong. Phien phat trien dang nhap bang chu so huu nen trinh duyet khong ve chung ra; do o muc ma, gioi han khai o AC-4. Ke tu ma sau khi dich, khong go tay. Tu 05/09 chan co CHIEU THUA: ung vien sinh tu cay cu phap (nhanh sai cua dung dieu kien co_khi) doi chieu voi bang — khoa hien trong ma ma bang khong co la DO. Chinh chieu do tim ra kenh.chepVaDanhDau, o thu tu bi sot khi ke tay.
